html:
Vietlook Travel will share with you a complete and concise set of experiences of traveling to Da Nang during the New Year, about festival events or many fun activities taking place during the New Year in the coastal city of Da Nang, and visiting famous scenic spots during the early spring, please refer to have the most enjoyable trip during this New Year.

Weather in Da Nang during Tet

The temperature in Da Nang during Tet usually fluctuates between 19 and 28 degrees Celsius, there is light drizzle in the early morning, the afternoon is sunny, not as hot as summer, so it is very suitable for your tour.

Where to stay when traveling to Da Nang during Tet?

In Da Nang, there are many hotels and homestays for tourists to choose from, all services are fully equipped, but it all depends on your budget.

If you like affordable prices, you can choose a homestay and experience the life of coastal people. On the contrary, if you like space and a beautiful view, you should choose 5-star hotels with 4-season swimming pool balconies and sea views. If you travel to Da Nang on your own, you should book a room early to avoid being sold out. On the contrary, if you go on a package tour, it will be included in the itinerary you choose from the beginning. Da Nang attractions during Tet

Ba Na Hills

Ba Na is a place with 4 seasons in a day, and has many beautiful landscapes, virtual living spots, top entertainment areas in Asia, especially including entertainment areas such as: Golden Bridge, Debay Wine Cellar, French Village, Mountain Train, Slide, …

Cu Lao Cham

A place that still retains its wild beauty, when coming here, visitors should experience taking a canoe to the island, admire the scenery and experience fishing on the island, because going during Tet, visitors should not experience swimming in the sea, because the sea will be cold at this time.

Asia Park

When coming here, visitors should participate in the sun wheel game, from here visitors can fully admire the beauty of the poetic Han River, in addition, in the park there are many games for children and food courts with delicious Asian dishes.

Linh Ung Pagoda

With a 67m high statue of Bodhisattva Avalokitesvara, from here you can enjoy the beauty of the sea and islands from above, a beautiful scene in the spring weather.

Hoi An Ancient Town

A place that not only attracts visitors with its peaceful scenery, the ancient town is lit up with lanterns, especially walking around to see the old town or releasing lanterns with many wishes. Especially when coming to Hoi An, you can also enjoy delicious dishes such as: Chicken rice, Cao Lau, Hen rice, Phuong bread, Adam Khanh, …

My Khe Beach

If you travel to Da Nang during Tet, take a walk along the beach to admire the peaceful scenery of the sea and islands, especially when coming to My Khe Beach in the summer, visitors can also participate in interesting games on the sea that will bring visitors the most unforgettable feelings.

What to eat when traveling to Da Nang during Tet?

Da Nang is not only a place with many beautiful stops, but when coming here, visitors can also enjoy delicious and attractive dishes, first of all, Quang noodles with soft and chewy noodles, served with vegetables to add delicious flavor.

Pork rice paper

A famous dish in Da Nang, for any tourist coming to Da Nang, this delicious dish cannot be missed, visitors can enjoy the dish right on the sidewalk or at roadside stalls or restaurants to feel the delicious flavor of Da Nang cuisine.

So above are the experiences of traveling to Da Nang during Tet, you should book yourself a tour to Da Nang right on this Lunar New Year to immerse yourself in festivals and events, visit famous places, participate in interesting games in the early spring of the new year, especially on the occasion of Tet, Da Nang also has a vibrant fireworks show.
